_comment: Roads that turned out to be the same tarmac under two names, and the id that won.
The corpus generator (scripts/generate-roads.mjs) skips every key here, so an
--overwrite run cannot resurrect a merged record. The build ships the map to
public/data/index.json, which is what lets /road/<old-id>/ still resolve.
Most entries are OSM's national-expressway numbering meeting the same road's
common name; the rest are short fragments OSM maps as separate relations.
Every pair below was confirmed by comparing the two real alignments, not by name.
